players.product: Memory burn-in sorters, test handlers and memory-module test handlers

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (amended): H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 37,070,649,767 and operating profit KRW 4,032,929,607 (H1 2025: revenue KRW 13,162,902 thousand, operating loss KRW 2,272,939 thousand); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 13,867,728,717 and operating profit KRW 2,338,131,189 (Q2 2025 operating loss KRW 449,798 thousand). Semiconductor inspection / automation equipment KRW 36,710M (99.03%) of revenue; exports KRW 10,315M
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 37,070,649,767; operating profit KRW 4,032,929,607 (H1 2025 operating loss KRW 2,272,939 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog KRW 21,857M at June 30, 2026 (total orders KRW 51,004M, delivered KRW 29,147M, parent basis); the report was amended on 08-19-2026 to exclude a KRW 16,519M order received on July 1, 2026

Outlook: memory-module test equipment secured large orders this year and the company expects the order and revenue expansion to continue into next year; it also expects orders for its main Burn-in Sorter in H2 2026 on rising DRAM demand

Preparing to supply BLU equipment for AI semiconductor products to global OSAT customers; pursuing development of and technical collaboration on HBM-related equipment, and running demo units and customer evaluations of a wafer probe station co-developed with a partner

The company says its Burn-In Sorter holds the No. 1 global market share (company claim) and that its equipment is used in the Burn-In process of Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and Micron; major customers' new overseas fab construction gives long-term equipment demand, and required quantities and timing are under discussion

Customer concentration (customers not named in the note): Customer A KRW 24,340,572 thousand (66%) and Customer B KRW 8,888,468 thousand (24%) of H1 2026 revenue, together 91%; in Q2 Customer A KRW 6,918,694 thousand (51%) and Customer B KRW 3,829,453 thousand (28%)
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 66%; Customer B 24% of H1 2026 revenue
